COMPREHENSION — TOPIC SYNTHESIS AND PRACTICE
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what comprehension — topic synthesis and practice means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Comprehension.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Look around a school compound in Machakos. Comprehension shows up in small daily actions — this page names them clearly. In plain words: topic synthesis and practice for Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Comprehension — Topic Synthesis and Practice helps you understand Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES.
• Meaning in plain words: topic synthesis and practice for Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES.
• Use accurate subject words — do not replace them with vague slogans.
• Link the idea to a real situation at a school compound in Machakos so you can remember it in an exam.
• Respect safety, honesty, and other people when you practise Comprehension.
• If two ideas look similar, compare them: say what is the same and what is different.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a school compound in Machakos: a learner investigates comprehension — topic synthesis and practice within Comprehension.
First, state the idea clearly: topic synthesis and practice for Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Next, apply it to one object or action at a school compound in Machakos and name what changes or what stays the same.
Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for ENGLISH ACTIVITIES.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
At a school compound in Machakos, practise comprehension — topic synthesis and practice during ordinary routines at home or school. Ask: what did I observe, which word or formula fits, and how do I check I am right? Use the diagram or working on this page as your model. Safety and respect come first.

SUMMARY
----
• Comprehension — Topic Synthesis and Practice helps you understand Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES.
• Meaning in plain words: topic synthesis and practice for Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES.
• Use accurate subject words — do not replace them with vague slogans.
• Link the idea to a real situation at a school compound in Machakos so you can remember it in an exam.

REVISION QUESTIONS
----
1. Define comprehension — topic synthesis and practice in your own words and give one clear example.
2. Describe a situation at a school compound in Machakos that shows Comprehension, using ideas from this page.
3. A learner makes a mistake about comprehension — topic synthesis and practice. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.

ANSWERS
----
1. Comprehension — Topic Synthesis and Practice helps you understand Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES. Example: connect it to something real at home, school, market, or a school compound in Machakos.
2. At a school compound in Machakos, observe carefully, name the correct idea from Comprehension, and explain with one subject fact from the main notes.
3. Wrong idea: mixing comprehension — topic synthesis and practice with a neighbouring concept or skipping the method. Correct idea: topic synthesis and practice for Comprehension in ENGLISH ACTIVITIES. Justification: follow the worked example (and diagram if shown) on this page.
